usage: PROG grid5000 controller [-h] --data-root DATA_ROOT [--site SITE]
 [--queue QUEUE] [--gpu-model GPU_MODEL]
 [--repo-id REPO_ID] [--max-stems MAX_STEMS]
 [--max-input-bytes MAX_INPUT_BYTES]
 [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE]
 [--inference-batch-size INFERENCE_BATCH_SIZE]
 [--walltime WALLTIME] [--run-id RUN_ID]
 [--hf-token HF_TOKEN]

Run and resume the local Grid5000 sentence-splitting controller.

 --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
 --inference-batch-size INFERENCE_BATCH_SIZE
